newsitem.title: USA: Santa Fe Pacific says has no comment on bid.
newsitem.headline: Santa Fe Pacific says has no comment on bid.

text.p: Santa Fe Pacific Gold Corp acknowledged Tuesday its receipt of a sweetened offer to be acquired by Newmont Mining Corp, although said it had no further comment at this time.
Earlier in the day, Newmont Mining raised its bid for Santa Fe to $16.50 per share, or about $2.2 billion, based on Monday's closing prices.
Newmont said it was offering 0.40 share of its stock for each Santa Fe share. Originally, on December 5, it offered 0.33 Newmont share for each Santa Fe share.
On December 9, Santa Fe agreed to be acquired by Homestake Mining for $17.42 per share, or $2.3 billion, based on market prices at the time.
